name: living-answer
means: A concept's means sentence is the answer to each domain question that names it; cq audits that the answer is alive and not known wrong — the concept is realized somewhere, none of its realizing projections moved since confirmation, it owes no re-read and is not marked drifted, and no concept it stands on through relations between concepts has moved projections, owes a re-read or is marked drifted, nor has a relation on the way moved — and never judges whether the sentence is true.

declared.delegated: agent judgment (Claude, claude-opus-5-5) read against this repository's code, user documentation and tests, under the owner's Stage 1 model-application task of 2026-11-05 (a bounded core-contract model); no person read or approved this wording; revised after the second non-author semantic review round (dwitbuk eyes) found the reached-concept conditions incomplete
